1.content: Assign higher scores to moves that strictly decrease the Manhattan distance to the goal compared to the current position.

2.content: Assign an overwhelming negative penalty (e.g., -1e6) to any move that results in a hazardous tile, moves off‑grid, or lands on a tile whose Manhattan distance to any hazard is 1. This safety penalty must be applied before any other heuristic, ensuring that unsafe moves are always rated far below any safe move regardless of distance‑to‑goal improvements.

3.content: When several safe moves equally reduce the Manhattan distance to the goal, assign higher scores to moves that increase the Manhattan distance to the nearest hazard (i.e., keep the agent as far as possible from hazards).
